context.body: Priesthood, practice, difficult statements, and final memory · 1 John 5:13–18
context.label: Priesthood, practice, difficult statements, and final memory

observations.body: Prayer for a sinning brother is distinguished from sin leading to death while all unrighteousness is called sin.
observations.label: There is sin leading to death

observations.body: The passage presents commanding, acting, knowing, investigating, judging, turning, living, and dying as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: commanding, acting, knowing, investigating, judging, turning, living, and dying

observations.body: The passage places command accountability and consequence beside commanding, acting, knowing, investigating, judging, turning, living, and dying.
observations.label: command accountability and consequence

payload.posture: Read 1 John 5:13–18 as evidence about sin, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the stated case defines its own actor, command, knowledge, judgment, and consequence rather than a rule for every sufferer
payload.title: There is sin leading to death
